reasons.fact: S2.5-01a extends the organizations-owned directory contract with portable ordinary/external/unknown management evidence and exact-ID membership deletion. WorkOS implements applied on normal void completion, unsupported only for its documented no-effect 422 refusal, and unchanged thrown errors with unknown effect otherwise. Hosted composition binds a required raw membership reader through the same SDK client so missing/null wire evidence is not defaulted to false; read queries, one-request reads, all role grants, and existing zero-retry/five-second limits remain. Member revisions include normalized management evidence. No application caller invokes deletion: admission, authorization, last-Admin safety, browser UI, storage, and recovery stay in later tickets. Registry prose describes the boundary and binding; all 13 registry diagrams, components, dependency edges, external service selection, and deployment remain unchanged. The shared public declaration and provider binding require internalInterface review; sensitiveBehavior covers membership deletion and unknown evidence.
